captions.detailed: This object is a dark gray skylight sunroof cassette designed for vehicle ventilation. It consists of a large, flat rectangular frame with rounded corners, housing a fixed glass panel on one side and an adjacent sliding glass vent insert. The sliding vent insert is mounted on internal guide rails, allowing it to move prismatically along the longitudinal axis to open and close.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a vent-only skylight sunroof cassette in CadQuery. The design should feature a solid dark gray outer frame with rounded corners, a fixed glass panel, and a sliding glass vent insert that moves along the longitudinal axis via a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base frame by creating a solid box, rounding its vertical edges, and cutting out two rectangular openings. It then models a fixed glass panel and a movable vent insert using thin boxes styled with a transparent blue glass material. Finally, it registers the frame as the base link, the vent insert as the child link, and establishes a prismatic articulation between them along the X-axis.
